tw.local.sqlQueryStr
SELECT
  PERSON_INFO.ID_PERSON AS idPerson,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_EMPLOYEE AS employeeNumber,
  PERSON_INFO.MANAGER_NIF AS nifManager,
  PERSON_INFO.NAME_PERSON as name,
  PERSON_INFO.DISPLAY_NAME as displayName,
  PERSON_INFO.NIF_PERSON AS fiscalNumber,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_SOCIETY as societyNumber,
  PERSON_INFO.SOCIETY as society,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_COMPANY as companyNumber,  
  PERSON_INFO.ID_COMPANY as idCompany,
  PERSON_INFO.NIF_COMPANY as nifCompany,
  PERSON_INFO.COMPANY as company,  
  PERSON_INFO.PHONE_WORK_CENTER as phoneWorkCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_DIVISION as extIdDivision,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_COST_CENTER as costCenterNumber,
  PERSON_INFO.COST_CENTER AS costCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.ID_COST_CENTER AS idCostCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.ACCOUNT_NAME as accountName,
  PERSON_INFO.EMAIL AS email,
  (CASE WHEN PERSON_INFO.HAS_PORTAL_ACCESS = 'S' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END) AS hasPortalAccess,
  PERSON_INFO.DIVISION  as division,
  PERSON_INFO.ID_SOCIETY as idSociety,
  PERSON_INFO.CARD_NUMBER as cardNumber, 
  DATE(PERSON_INFO.DT_ACTIVITY_START) as dtActivityStart,
  value(USER_COMPANY_PROFILE.IS_TO_SEND_ALERT,'') AS isToSendAlert,
  value(CATEGORIES.CATEGORIE, '') as category,
  value(CATEGORIES.EXT_ID, '') as extIdCategory,
  value(CATEGORIES.ID, 0) as idCategory,
  PERSON_INFO.WORK_CENTER as workCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.ID_WORK_CENTER as idWorkCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.DT_ANTIQUE as dtAntique
FROM PERSON_INFO
	LEFT JOIN USER_COMPANY_PROFILE 
		 ON USER_COMPANY_PROFILE.ID_PERSON = PERSON_INFO.ID_PERSON AND USER_COMPANY_PROFILE.ID_PORTAL_APP = ?
	LEFT JOIN PERSONS_CATEGORY	
		ON PERSONS_CATEGORY.ID_PERSON = PERSON_INFO.ID_PERSON AND PERSONS_CATEGORY.DT_ACTIVITY_END IS NULL
	LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES
		ON  CATEGORIES.ID =PERSONS_CATEGORY.ID_CATEGORY	 
WHERE ( PERSON_INFO.DT_ACTIVITY_END IS NULL or date(PERSON_INFO.DT_ACTIVITY_END) >= date(current timestamp) )
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.ACCOUNT_NAME = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.NIF_PERSON = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.ID_SOCIETY = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_EMPLOYEE = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.ID_PERSON = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.CARD_NUMBER = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_SOCIETY = ?) 
	 	  	  WITH UR

	--VRM_BUDGET.TOTAL_ESTIMATE  ,
   VRM_HISTORY_DATE.NEW_DATE as ORIGINAL_SCHEDULED_DATE,
	 (DAYS (COALESCE(VRM_BUDGET.RESPONSE_DATE,CURRENT TIMESTAMP)) - DAYS (VRM_BUDGET.REQUEST_DATE))
    as NUM_DAYS_IN_BUDGET,
	 (DAYS (COALESCE(VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.VEHICLE_READY_DATE,CURRENT TIMESTAMP)) - DAYS (APPROVAL_DATE))	
    as NUM_DAYS_PREPARATION,
	 (DAYS (COALESCE(VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.DELIVERY_DATE,CURRENT TIMESTAMP)) - DAYS (VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.VEHICLE_SENT_DT))
    as NUM_DAYS_VEHICLE_OUT 
    FROM VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST 
    
	  LEFT JOIN INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO ON INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO.ID_PLATFORM = VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.ADDRESSEE_PLATFORM AND

	                                                                                                                                      INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO.ID_POLE     = VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.ADDRESSEE_POLE 
	                                                                                                                                      and
                                                   INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO.DT_START_AFTERSALES is not null and 
                                                   INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO.DT_END_AFTERSALES is null
                                                   
	  LEFT JOIN INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO_REQ ON INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO_REQ.ID_PLATFORM = VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.COMMERCIAL_OFFICE_PLATFORM AND             
	                                              INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO_REQ.ID_BRAND    = VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.COMMERCIAL_OFFICE_BRAND AND
	                                              INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO_REQ.ID_POLE     = VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.COMMERCIAL_OFFICE_POLE  and
                                                   ( (INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO_REQ.DT_START_SALES is not null and 
                                                   INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO_REQ.DT_END_SALES is null ) or
                                                   (INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO_REQ.DT_START_AFTERSALES is not null and 
                                                   INTRGSC_DEALER_STRUCTURE_INFO_REQ.DT_END_AFTERSALES is null) )                                                                                      
	 LEFT JOIN VRM_BUDGET ON
		VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.ID = VRM_BUDGET.ID_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST
		AND VRM_BUDGET.ID IN (SELECT MAX(ID) FROM VRM_BUDGET WHERE VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.ID = VRM_BUDGET.ID_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST )
	 LEFT JOIN VRM_VEHICLE ON
		VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.ID_VEHICLE = VRM_VEHICLE.ID
	 LEFT JOIN VRM_HISTORY_DATE ON
		VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.ID = VRM_HISTORY_DATE.ID_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST
		AND VRM_HISTORY_DATE.ID IN (SELECT MIN(VRM_HISTORY_DATE.ID) FROM VRM_HISTORY_DATE where VRM_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST.ID = VRM_HISTORY_DATE.ID_RECONDITIONING_REQUEST)
